announcements.text: Save Backup and Screenshot Gallery are ready
Video Clipper, RetroArch Config, EPUB Pro

plugins.name: PDF Support
plugins.tagline: Render PDF files in GD-X Library
plugins.description: Full PDF rendering inside GD-X Library. Adds page navigation, zoom, pan and page jump for any .pdf file. Runs MuPDF via the Python binding PyMuPDF, downloaded once and stored locally.
features: Zoom in / out with L2 / R2
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
PDF Support installs PyMuPDF (a Python binding for MuPDF) the first time you open a PDF file from GD-X Library.

The download is 19 MB and is stored in data/downloads/. After installation, all future PDFs open instantly with page navigation, zoom and pan.

If PyMuPDF is not installed and you try to open a PDF, GD-X Library shows a message and offers to install it through FGD-X Plugins.

To remove, press Y in this screen.

plugins.name: Archive Extender
plugins.description: Unlocks additional archive formats using tools already present on muOS. RAR / CBR via unrar. ISO / IMG / DMG / 7z / TAR.ZST via 7z.
features: RAR and CBR archives (comics) via unrar
ISO, IMG, DMG disc images via 7z
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.installed_check: command -v 7z >/dev/null && command -v unrar >/dev/null && echo ok || echo no
plugins.documentation:
Archive Extender unlocks additional archive formats using the 7z and unrar binaries already present on muOS.

Supported formats added:
- RAR archives and CBR comics via unrar
- ISO, IMG and DMG disc images via 7z
- 7z, CB7 and CBT archives
- TAR.ZST and TAR.LZ4 compressed tarballs

All extraction is handled through Archive Rt (the archive viewer). No download required. This plugin is enabled by default.

plugins.name: Office Reader
plugins.description: Opens Microsoft Office documents in Office:Rt. DOCX and PPTX show text with paragraphs and slide breaks. XLSX shows the first sheet as a table. Uses unzip + a small XML parser.
features: XLSX: first sheet as a scrollable table
Native unzip (no extra tools to install)
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.installed_check: command -v unzip >/dev/null && echo ok || echo no
plugins.documentation:
Office Reader opens Microsoft Office documents inside Office:Rt.

Supported formats:
- DOCX: paragraphs, headings, lists and slide breaks preserved as text
- XLSX: the first sheet is shown as a scrollable table
- PPTX: text extraction per slide

The plugin uses unzip (already present on muOS) plus a small XML parser written in pure Lua. No conversion step, no download, instant open.

Note: styling, images and complex tables are not rendered. This is a text-first reader.

plugins.name: Web View
plugins.description: Browse and render local HTML files with the built-in Net-Sphere Reader engine. Real formatted content, not source code: headings, paragraphs, lists, bold, italic, images and horizontal rules.
features: Tags: h1-h6, p, br, ul, ol, li, b, i, a, img
Rendered / source view toggle with X
Previous / next file with L1 / R1
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Web View renders local HTML files through Net-Sphere Reader, the built-in engine of File-GD X.

Where it scans:
- Documents
- Downloads
- Books
On both SD cards and the home folder.

What it renders:
- Headings h1 to h6
- Paragraphs, line breaks, horizontal rules
- Lists (ul, ol, li)
- Inline bold, italic, underline, strikethrough
- Links, images, preformatted text, blockquotes

Not a browser: CSS and JavaScript are ignored. Perfect for saved articles, documentation and offline pages.

Press X to toggle between rendered view and source code view. Press Y for the document outline.

plugins.name: Chou Henka
plugins.tagline: Rich media player: audio, video, playlists, EQ
plugins.description: Full-featured media player. Audio: playlist, queue, 6 EQ presets, seek, volume, speed and a 32-band animated visualizer. Video: launches mpv fullscreen with hardware decode.
features: 6 EQ presets: flat bass vocal rock jazz electro
plugins.usage: Open audio / video from File Explorer
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.installed_check: command -v mpv >/dev/null && command -v python3 >/dev/null && command -v ffprobe >/dev/null && echo ok || echo no
plugins.documentation:
Chou Henka is a full-featured media player for audio and video.

Audio mode:
- Playlist and queue management
- Prev / Next with L1 / R1
- Play / Pause with A
- Seek ±10s with D-pad left/right
- Volume up/down with D-pad up/down
- 6 equalizer presets: flat, bass, vocal, rock, jazz, electro
- 32-band animated visualizer

Video mode:
- Launches mpv fullscreen with hardware decode (v4l2request)
- H.264 up to 1080p60 on the Allwinner H700
- HEVC 8-bit partial hardware support

Metadata is read from ffprobe: title, artist, album, bitrate, duration.

plugins.name: Comic Reader+
plugins.tagline: Manga and comics: page turning, RTL
plugins.description: Specialised reader for CBZ, CBR, CB7 and CBT comics. Adds manga mode (right-to-left page order), double-page spreads, page transitions and a bookmark list.
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.installed_check: command -v unzip >/dev/null && echo ok || echo no
plugins.documentation:
Comic Reader+ is a specialised reader for CBZ, CBR, CB7 and CBT comics.

Controls:
- L1 / R1: previous / next page
- A: skip forward
- X: toggle manga mode (right-to-left page order)
- Y: toggle double-page spread
- START: bookmark current page
- L2 / R2: zoom

Bookmarks are stored per file in data/comic_bookmarks.json. Next time you open the same comic, it resumes from your bookmark.

In manga mode, left and right arrows are swapped so navigation feels natural for Japanese reading order.

plugins.name: Font Preview
plugins.tagline: Browse TTF, OTF and WOFF fonts
plugins.description: Preview any TrueType or OpenType font installed on the device. Shows a sample alphabet, numbers, punctuation and a pangram at multiple sizes.
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Font Preview loads any TrueType or OpenType font and shows it at four different sizes.

For each size (12, 18, 24, 36 px) you see:
- The uppercase alphabet A to Z
- The lowercase alphabet a to z
- Digits and punctuation 0-9 !?@#$%&*()-_=+
- A pangram: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog"

Supported formats: TTF, OTF, WOFF and WOFF2.

Open any font file from File Explorer to see the preview. Use up/down to scroll through the sizes.

plugins.name: Hex Viewer
plugins.tagline: Read-only hexadecimal view of any file
plugins.description: Inspect any file at the byte level. Classic 16-bytes-per-row layout with ASCII sidebar. Read-only by design: no editing, no accidental writes.
features: 16 bytes per row with ASCII sidebar
Jump to top / bottom with Y / X
Works on any file, binary or text
plugins.usage: Open any file via context menu > Open in Hex Viewer
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Hex Viewer shows any file at the byte level with a classic 16-bytes-per-row layout.

Columns:
- Offset (hexadecimal)
- Hex bytes (16 per row)
- ASCII sidebar (printable characters, dots for non-printable)

Controls:
- Up / Down: scroll one line
- L1 / R1: scroll one page
- Y: jump to top
- X: jump to bottom

Read-only by design: no editing, no accidental writes. Reads up to 2 MB per file for memory safety on handheld devices.

Access it from the file manager context menu: X on any file, then Open in Hex Viewer.

plugins.name: Save Backup
plugins.tagline: Auto-backup emulator saves to SD2 or USB
plugins.description: Scans save folders of every emulator (RetroArch, Dolphin, PPSSPP, DraStic and more), then mirrors them to a second SD or USB stick. One-tap backup, one-tap restore, automatic daily snapshot.
features: One-tap backup to SD2 or USB
plugins.usage: Open from Plugin list, choose destination, run backup
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Save Backup protects your emulator saves by mirroring them to a second SD card or USB drive.

Emulators detected (10+):
- RetroArch saves and states
- Dolphin (GameCube / Wii)
- PPSSPP
- DraStic
- Pico-8
- ScummVM
- Flycast

How it works:
- Scans every known save folder
- Shows files and total size per folder
- Press A to backup everything to SD2 (or USB if present)
- Press X to see snapshots and restore

Snapshots are timestamped: 20260925_143022. The source files are never touched.

plugins.name: Screenshot Gallery
plugins.description: A single gallery for all your emulator screenshots. Filter by system, sort by date, view fullscreen, delete in bulk and export selected shots to a custom folder.
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Screenshot Gallery is a single hub for all your emulator screenshots.

It scans common screenshot folders:
- /run/muos/storage/screenshot
- /mnt/mmc/screenshots
- /mnt/sdcard/screenshots
- /mnt/mmc/retroarch/screenshots

Controls:
- D-pad: navigate the grid (4 columns)
- A: fullscreen with info strip
- X: delete single screenshot (with confirmation)
- Y: rescan folders

Thumbnails load lazily to keep memory low on handheld devices. Up to 200 screenshots are shown per scan.

plugins.name: Image Resizer
plugins.tagline: Batch resize images for muOS wallpapers and icons
plugins.description: Resize, convert and rename images in bulk. Perfect for preparing muOS wallpapers at 640x480, icon sets at any size, or converting PNG / JPG / WebP with a single button.
features: Batch resize any number of images
plugins.usage: Open from Plugin list, mark images, choose preset, resize
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Image Resizer prepares images for muOS wallpapers, icon sets or any custom use.

Presets:
- 640x480 (muOS default)
- 480x640 (vertical)
- 720x720 (square)
- 1024x768
- 1280x720
- 256x256, 128x128, 64x64 (icons)

How it works:
- Marks the images you want with SELECT
- Press A to resize all marked
- Output goes to data/resized/

Aspect ratio is preserved: the image is scaled down and padded with black bars to match the target size. Uses ffmpeg which is already present on muOS.

plugins.name: Video Clipper
plugins.tagline: Extract clips and GIFs with ffmpeg
plugins.description: Mark in and out points on any video, then export a clip in any format ffmpeg supports. Includes an animated GIF preset for sharing.
features: In / out point marking on a timeline
Export clip as MP4, MKV or WebM
Uses ffmpeg already present on muOS
plugins.usage: Open any video file from Plugin list
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
Video Clipper extracts clips and GIFs from any video file.

Controls:
- L1 / R1: seek ±10 seconds
- D-pad left / right: seek ±1 second
- D-pad up: set IN point at cursor
- D-pad down: set OUT point at cursor
- X: cycle export format
- Y: reset IN and OUT
- A: export the range

Export formats:
- MP4 (H.264 + AAC)
- MKV (stream copy)
- WebM (VP9 + Opus)
- Animated GIF (480px, 15 fps)

Output goes to data/clips/ with a timestamp. Uses ffmpeg already present on muOS.

plugins.name: EPUB Reader Pro
plugins.tagline: TOC, bookmarks, reading themes -- already integrated
plugins.description: EPUB Reader Pro is not a separate plugin: its features are already built into GD-X Library. Open any .epub file to get chapter TOC, per-file bookmarks with resume, three reading themes and skip navigation.
features: Reading themes: dark, amber, light (X key)
plugins.author: sirpips
plugins.documentation:
EPUB Reader Pro is not a separate plugin: its features are already built into GD-X Library.

Open any .epub file from File Explorer to get:

- Chapter TOC overlay (Y key): full chapter tree with jump
- Bookmark current page (START key): saved per file, resumed next time
- Reading themes (X key): dark, amber, light
- Skip navigation (L1 / R1)
- Zoom (L2 / R2)

Themes are stored in memory only; your choice is per-session. Bookmarks persist across restarts.

Renders both EPUB2 (toc.ncx) and EPUB3 (nav.xhtml) chapter structures.

muos_apps.name: VOID-Desk 'Nexus'
muos_apps.tagline: The definitive desktop layer for muOS
muos_apps.desc: A real Linux machine lives inside your handheld. VoidDesk bootstraps XFCE, IceWM, and LXDE desktops in isolated Ubuntu chroots, launched on demand.
features: Native interface: menus, files, text editor
No X server, no compositor, no GPU required

muos_apps.name: Rt:Tailscale
muos_apps.desc: Connect your muOS device to your Tailscale tailnet. Browse peers, send and receive files via Taildrop, manage exit nodes, and auth by QR code.
features: Tailnet control with a single button press
QR code auth plus 3 visual themes

muos_apps.name: SPDW BGM Normalizer
muos_apps.desc: Convert, normalize, and optimize your music for the ultimate handheld BGM experience. Unifies MP3, FLAC, and WAV libraries into normalized OGG files.
features: EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770 loudness targeting
MP3, FLAC, WAV, M4A, AAC, WMA, OPUS -> OGG

muos_apps.name: Dolphin Rt:Core
muos_apps.tagline: GameCube and Wii emulation for H700
muos_apps.desc: GameCube and Wii emulation on muOS, tuned for the Allwinner H700. Three editions: Standalone, Bash Arsenal (21 profiles, 17 toggles), and Frontendone.
features: Dedicated compatibility database with FPS stats
Bash Arsenal: profiles, toggles, logs, reports
Surgical tuning for a 1 GB RAM budget
